lead.description: a treated group's before-and-after change minus the same change in a comparison group

overview_sentence: [Difference in differences](articles/difference-in-differences.qmd) subtracts a comparison group's change from a treated group's change.

self_checks.title: Two gaps
self_checks.prompt: Treated means are 150 before and 140 after. Comparison means are 148 before and 146 after. What is the difference in differences of the post-treatment gap minus the pre-treatment gap?
self_checks.answer: The post-treatment gap is -6 and the pre-treatment gap is 2, so the difference in differences is -8.

self_checks.title: Changed comparison
self_checks.prompt: The comparison group's later mean is 144 instead of 146. Treated means stay 140 and 150, and the earlier comparison mean stays 148. What is the difference in differences?
